purpose: Replace type-only labels for the Type-0x15 primary-counter response and Type-0x1A gated death-response paths.

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_DecrementPrimaryCounterResponse

contract.shared_block: Enters Actor_ProcessSharedPlayerCollision before the response branch
contract.response: When PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is clear, decrements INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS three times, changes the source actor to Type-0x14, installs PLAYER_ANIM_STATE_1226CE, and clears PLAYER_ANIMATION_TIMER

evidence: Direct Type-0x14 actor and player-animation state writes

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_SpawnType1ADeathResponse

contract.gate: Runs only when PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is nonzero
contract.cleanup: Sets PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE1A_LATCH and releases the current actor

evidence: Direct action-response gate and Type-0x1A latch write
Direct actor release and death-template initialization calls

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish the Type-0x15 primary-counter response from the Type-0x1A gated death response while retaining dispatch-type aliases.
